'''Gesselle Organa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and a member of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
During the civil war on Alderaan, against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]-backed [[House of Thul]], Gesselle Organa and her troops were protecting a tremendously powerful force field, which was powered by siphoning power directly from Alderaan's [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] generator. However, a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] managed to get inside and sabotaged the generator to force it into the backup mode&mdash;cutting off any excess power drains, thereby deactivating the Organa force field.

After the [[Sith Warrior]] sabotaged the planetary generator and killed numerous [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Organa, along with [[Blenks]], [[Kan'grell]], and [[Prinn]] confronted the Sith, who was looking for information about Jaesa Willsaam, Organa's former handmaiden. Organa decided to make an offer to the Sith, which was refused. The Sith started to torture Blenks, who was Organa's lover. Refusing to watch him [[Death/Legends|die]], Organa revealed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]]'s [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were still servants at [[Castle Organa]]. After getting the information on Willsaam's parents, the Warrior executed Organa and her bodyguards for defying the Empire.
{{Endgame}}
